title: Azure OpenAI Service downtime affecting Langdock users who bring their own models
summary: Microsoft Azure is currently experiencing a downtime across its OpenAI Services in the Sweden Central region: https://azure.status.microsoft/en-us/status This is affecting users who configured their own OpenAI models hosted in the Sweden Central region. As a workaround, we recommend deploying the models in a different (EU) region. If you use the models provided by Langdock, this does not affect you.
